checkpoint_policy: immutable final step-000031 only; no selection, early stopping or tuning

steps: input must be a strict UTF-8 string
strip ASCII space, tab, carriage return and line feed at both ends
parse exactly as a base-10 decimal; negative zero equals zero; no exponent, comma, currency, percent, fraction or unit is accepted
two values match iff their exact decimal values are equal

candidate_methods.empty_pool: retain invalid-empty-candidate-pool and assign zero to all three common item metrics; candidate recall is zero; only the separately labeled injected-gold answer diagnostic may run
candidate_methods.answer_selection: for a non-empty pool, if every score is finite choose the greatest score and break exact ties by lowest frozen candidate index; otherwise retain invalid-nonfinite-scores and score all three common item metrics zero
candidate_methods.relation_selection: read only relation_logits[0,1,:] for event1 source to event2 target, separately for original and counterfactual inputs; require each exact five-logit vector finite, choose greatest logit and break exact ties by lowest relation_label_order index; wrong shape or non-finite vectors make the applicable relation metric zero
candidate_methods.candidate_recall: one iff at least one valid parsed answer in the exact-deduplicated gold-blind candidate pool matches gold under strict-decimal-v1; invalid raw generations and later train-only gold injection do not count
candidate_methods.gold_injection_sensitivity: answer-accuracy contribution with exact gold appended at the final candidate position minus contribution on the untouched gold-blind pool, paired by source_id; diagnostic only

same_data_sft.prediction: use the separately hashed same-data SFT protocol parser; compare its three string fields under strict-decimal-v1 and exact relation labels

uncertainty.item_accuracy_interval: Wilson score interval with z=1.959963984540054 and denominator 36
uncertainty.resampling: sample 36 source_id positions with replacement; paired methods use the identical sampled positions; after all three seeds exist, each sampled source contribution is the arithmetic mean of its three seed-level zero-or-one contributions
uncertainty.confidence_interval: 2.5 and 97.5 percentiles by Hyndman-Fan type 7 linear interpolation over the 10000 paired metric differences

holm_family.when: only after seeds 13, 42 and 2026 all verify for all three methods
holm_family.procedure: sort raw p ascending and break ties by UTF-8 hypothesis_id; for sorted position i from 1 to 6 compute min(1,(7-i)*p_i), take the cumulative maximum through i, then restore hypothesis_id order

failure_policy: missing, duplicate, extra, non-finite, unbound or unparsable predictions remain immutable typed failures with zero item contribution; aggregation never silently drops an item
